# `db/queries/repos.ts`

## Overview

Provides query helpers for managing repository records in the database. Each function operates on the `repos` table and handles common CRUD operations, including an upsert-based find-or-create pattern and cascading deletion of dependent rows.

---

## Exports

### `findOrCreate`

Finds an existing repo by `provider` + `full_name`, or creates a new one. Uses an upsert (`INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE`) so that `updated_at` stays current on repeated imports.

```ts
import { findOrCreate } from 'db/queries/repos';
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `provider` | `string` | ✅ | The repository provider (e.g. `"github"`). |
| `fullName` | `string` | ✅ | The full repository name (e.g. `"owner/repo"`). |
| `defaultBranch` | `string` | ❌ | The default branch for the repository. |

#### Returns

```ts
Promise<{
  id: number;
  createdAt: Date | null;
  updatedAt: Date | null;
  provider: string;
  fullName: string;
  defaultBranch: string | null;
  settings: unknown;
}>
```

#### Example

```ts
const repo = await findOrCreate('github', 'acme/my-repo', 'main');
console.log(repo.id);
```

### `getById`

Returns a single repo by its `id`, or `undefined` if not found.

```ts
import { getById } from 'db/queries/repos';
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `number` | ✅ | The unique identifier of the repository. |

#### Returns

```ts
Promise<{
  id: number;
  createdAt: Date | null;
  updatedAt: Date | null;
  provider: string;
  fullName: string;
  defaultBranch: string | null;
  settings: unknown;
}>
```

#### Example

```ts
const repo = await getById(42);
if (repo) {
  console.log(repo.fullName);
}
```

### `deleteById`

Deletes a repo and all dependent rows (tasks and their children, `user_repo_access`). Returns the number of repo rows deleted (`0` or `1`).

```ts
import { deleteById } from 'db/queries/repos';
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `number` | ✅ | The unique identifier of the repository to delete. |

#### Returns

```ts
Promise<number>
```

The number of deleted repo rows. Will be `0` if no repo with the given `id` was found, or `1` on success.

#### Example

```ts
const deletedCount = await deleteById(42);
if (deletedCount === 0) {
  console.warn('Repo not found.');
}
```

### `updateSettings`

Updates the `settings` field of a repository.

```ts
import { updateSettings } from 'db/queries/repos';
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `repoId` | `number` | ✅ | The unique identifier of the repository to update. |
| `settings` | `Record<string, unknown>` | ✅ | Key-value pairs to store as the repository's settings. |

#### Returns

```ts
Promise<{
  id: number;
  provider: string;
  fullName: string;
  defaultBranch: string | null;
  settings: unknown;
  createdAt: Date | null;
  updatedAt: Date | null;
}>
```

#### Example

```ts
const updated = await updateSettings(42, {
  autoMerge: true,
  reviewers: ['alice', 'bob'],
});
console.log(updated.settings);
```
